zh-CN.title: 唱片铺气泡与试听
items: 四款歌手气泡各有专属纹样，人物贴近气泡边缘。
点气泡侧边的光盘直接试听。光盘贴着气泡边缘，播放时加速旋转。
98 张专辑的试听片段延长至约 16 秒，专辑详情新增可拖动的播放进度条。

en.title: Record Shop Bubbles and Clips
items: Each artist bubble has its own texture, with the portrait tucked against the bubble edge.
Tap a disc at the bubble edge to listen. The disc spins faster during playback.
All 98 album excerpts now run for about 16 seconds. Album details have a new player with a seek bar.
